name: IdentityMirror | Sync Customizer Logo to Login
author: Bonny Elangbam

sections.description:
IdentityMirror is a lightweight branding utility that automatically reflects your site’s custom logo (from Site Identity) onto the WordPress login page.

It is designed for agencies and developers who want a professional, white-labeled login experience without configuring complex settings options.

Features

  • Zero Configuration – “Mirrors” the logo already set in Appearance → Customize → Site Identity
  • Automatic Fallback – If no custom logo is set, it gracefully defaults to the WordPress logo
  • Smart Sizing – Automatically calculates aspect ratios to fit the login container
  • Clean Code – Lightweight execution with no database bloat
  • Translation Ready – Fully internationalized

How It Works

  1. Install and activate IdentityMirror
  2. Set your logo in Appearance → Customize → Site Identity
  3. That’s it! Your login page is now branded.

Perfect For

  • Agencies providing white-label solutions
  • Developers who need a “set it and forget it” branding tool
  • Site owners who want consistent branding from the login screen to the dashboard

Support

For support, please visit the support forum or contact me through my website.

Privacy Policy

This plugin does not collect, store, or transmit any user data. It does not use cookies or tracking.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Navigate to Plugins → Add New
  3. Search for “IdentityMirror”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  3. Navigate to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  4. Choose the downloaded zip file and click “Install Now”
  5. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu
sections.faq:
Where do I upload my logo?

You don’t need a special upload page! Just go to Appearance → Customize → Site Identity. This plugin “mirrors” whatever logo you set there.

Do I need to configure any settings?

No. IdentityMirror has no settings page. It is designed to work automatically.

What size should my logo be?

The plugin handles sizing automatically (max width 320px). For the crispest results, ensure your Site Identity logo is high quality and has a transparent background.

Will this slow down my site?

No. It adds zero database queries for settings and only loads a few lines of CSS on the login page itself.
